paragraphs: The Pixel 11, no matter which model you look at, ranges from bright and loud to quiet and stealthy colorways. Google-made cases launching with the Pixel 11 series match the new model’s palettes, and it even includes a clear case this time.

If any company were to produce a good case for the Pixel 11 out of the gate, it’d be the company that makes the phone it fits. Google has been making accompanying cases for years, and they’ve generally been very good options. The true draw is how they’re styled. Pixel cases from Google almost always have color-matching, and the Pixel 11 series is no different.

There are five different case colorways available for the base and Pro devices. The base model gets Hibiscus, Frost, Obsidian, and Pistachio, while the Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL cases are available in Canyon, Fog, Obsidian, and Olive.

The fifth case choice is new this year. It’s a clear case that shows off the inner Qi2 magnet array, much like a MagSafe case or a good portion of available cases for devices with Qi2. Google hasn’t released a clear case for these recent Pixel phones, so it’s nice to see.

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold seems to get the least amount of attention. It naturally comes with just two color choices – Olive and Obsidian. Google didn’t extend the clear case series to its third-generation foldable phone. It does, however, actually get hinge protection, unlike the previous model. It has a nice textured surface that runs along the left of the phone and over the whole device. It feels great in the hand.
Pixelsnap is a common theme throughout each case, as it should be. But it extends beyond that into dedicated magnetic accessories.

Google released new colors for the Pixelsnap Ring Stand to build on the one colorway offered with the Pixel 10 series. We’re getting a choice of Canyon, Olive, or Obsidian for the new phones. Moonstone will continue to be sold, since nothing has changed on the hardware end.

That doesn’t extend to the Pixelsnap Charger Stand, though. Hardware is the same as a year ago, even though the Pixel 11 series, as a whole, increased wireless charging speed to 25W. That does mean that every phone can now fully take advantage of the charger’s max speed.
